mcqs.question: Which of the following fractions is the greatest when the denominators are the same?
mcqs.explanation: When fractions have a common denominator, the fraction with the larger numerator is larger. Among 3/9, 5/9, 7/9 and 1/9, 7/9 has the largest numerator, so it is the greatest.

mcqs.question: Which fraction is the smallest when the numerators are the same?
mcqs.explanation: With a common numerator, a larger denominator makes the fraction smaller. Among the given fractions, 4/11 has the largest denominator, so it is the smallest.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly explains how to compare 2/3 and 4/6?

options.A: Convert 2/3 to 4/6 and then compare; they are equal.
options.B: Convert 4/6 to 2/3 and then compare; they are equal.
options.C: Both fractions are already equivalent, so they are equal.
options.D: All of the above statements are correct.

mcqs.answer: Both fractions are already equivalent, so they are equal.
mcqs.explanation: 2/3 and 4/6 represent the same rational number because 4/6 simplifies to 2/3. Therefore they are equal without any further conversion.

mcqs.question: Arrange the fractions 3/8, 1/2, and 5/12 in ascending (smallest to largest) order.
mcqs.explanation: Convert to decimals: 3/8 = 0.375, 5/12 ≈ 0.4167, 1/2 = 0.5. Ordering from smallest to largest gives 3/8, then 5/12, then 1/2.

mcqs.question: Place the fractions 7/10, 2/5, and 3/4 in descending (largest to smallest) order.
mcqs.explanation: Decimal equivalents: 3/4 = 0.75, 7/10 = 0.70, 2/5 = 0.40. From largest to smallest the order is 3/4, then 7/10, then 2/5.

mcqs.learning_point: Use number lines to compare fractions
mcqs.question: On a number line from 0 to 1, points are marked for 2/5 and 3/7. Which point lies farther to the right?

options.C: Both points are at the same position
options.D: It cannot be determined without a drawn line

mcqs.explanation: 2/5 = 0.40 and 3/7 ≈ 0.4286. Since 0.4286 > 0.40, the point representing 3/7 is farther to the right, indicating it is the larger fraction.

mcqs.question: Statement: "Among 5/9 and 7/9, the fraction with the larger denominator is greater." Is this statement true or false?
mcqs.explanation: The fractions share the same denominator (9). When denominators are equal, the fraction with the larger numerator is greater. Here 7/9 > 5/9, so the statement about the denominator is false.

mcqs.question: Which fraction is larger: 6/11 or 6/13? Explain your reasoning.

options.D: Cannot compare without converting to decimals

mcqs.explanation: Both fractions have the same numerator (6). The fraction with the smaller denominator is larger because the same number of parts is divided into fewer pieces. Since 11 < 13, 6/11 > 6/13.
